verdict.rationale: Buzz ships first-party self-hosting: a Helm chart that can point at your own managed Postgres, Redis and S3, plus a single-node/VPS bundle that needs no external services. Running your own relay this way lets you decide where your data physically lives. There is no documented region or residency selection for operator-hosted workspaces; residency control comes only from where you deploy it yourself. missing for 10: a region/residency picker for hosted workspaces, explicit data-residency documentation or guarantees, independent corroboration of residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Run your own relay for one community, or let an operator host thousands on shared infrastructure
The project lives in one place, and that place is yours.
This is the single-node/VPS deployment bundle.
